title: Cookie Policy — Khalid Farhan | Khalid Farhan
metaDesc: Cookie policy for khalidfarhan.com. What cookies we use and how to control them.

blocks.text: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when you visit a website. They help websites remember your preferences and understand how you use them.
These cookies are essential for the website to function. They cannot be disabled.

items.text: affiliate_ref: Stores your affiliate referral code for 30 days to attribute commissions correctly.
affiliate_token: Authentication token for affiliate dashboard access.

blocks.text: These cookies help us understand how visitors use the site. Data is anonymised.

items.text: Google Analytics 4: Page views, session data, traffic sources. We use IP anonymisation. Data is retained for 14 months.

blocks.text: Set by third-party advertising platforms to measure campaign performance.

items.text: Facebook Pixel: Tracks conversions from Meta Ads campaigns.
Google Ads: Tracks conversions from Google Ads campaigns.

blocks.text: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to view, block, and delete cookies. Note that blocking some cookies may affect website functionality.
To opt out of Google Analytics: Google Analytics Opt-out
To manage Facebook Pixel: Facebook Privacy Settings
